556:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

556:t_1:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「...So this is $$宗介$$'s new AS...」

556:t_1:5.en:
$$アル$$
「Its name is $$レーバテイン$$. It takes its name from a sword that appears in mythology.」

556:t_1:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Still, I never thought Al would turn out to be alive and well.」

556:t_1:7.en:
$$アル$$
「After I lost my body, $$アーバレスト$$, in $$第２新東京市$$, I was recovered by the $$ミスリル$$ Intelligence Division, and I obtained this new body.」

556:t_1:8.en:
$$アル$$
「With $$レーバテイン$$, Sergeant $$相良$$, as he is now, can keep the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ running at all times.」

556:t_1:9.en:
$$アル$$
「Furthermore, by fitting the Emergency Deployment Booster, $$レーバテイン$$ is also equipped with a limited capacity for flight.」

556:t_1:10.en:
$$アル$$
「That said, since priority went to attack equipment and running it, this unit has problems with electronic warfare weaponry, and carries no $$ＥＣＳ$$ either.」

556:t_1:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, there's no doubt it's a powerful machine.」

556:t_1:12.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's a real dream AS, all right.」

556:t_1:13.en:
$$アル$$
「The only ones who can operate a machine like this are Sergeant $$相良$$ and I.」

556:t_1:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you bragging, by any chance?」

556:t_1:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Al seems to have become even more human than before.」

556:t_1:16.en:
$$宗介$$
(Al is learning human emotions in the midst of battle...)

556:t_1:17.en:
$$宗介$$
(This thing has already gone beyond the category of AI. I don't know what that will give rise to, but...)

556:t_1:18.en:
$$マオ$$
「Our ASs, the KMF, and $$キリコ$$'s dog were all upgraded by $$ミスリル$$ too.」

556:t_1:19.en:
$$クルツ$$
「In the final battle against $$アマルガム$$, we'll show 'em the new power of us $$ＳＲＴ$$ team. Right, Sis?」

556:t_1:20.en:
$$マオ$$
「Only if you stop playing dead and do your job properly.」

556:t_1:23.en:
$$さやか$$
($$マオ$$ and $$クルツ$$...? Have they gotten a little closer?)

556:t_1:24.en:
$$甲児$$
(Looks like it. Man... this is going to be fun to watch from here on.)

556:t_1:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...$$ゼロ$$. I hear you went to the ruins on $$神根島$$.」

556:t_1:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I made contact with the $$集合無意識$$ there, and tried to find an answer to the question within me.」

556:t_1:28.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「In psychology, it refers to an aggregate of consciousness that goes beyond the individual, lying deeper still beneath a person's unconscious, but...」

556:t_1:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Interpreted broadly, it is the common consciousness shared by all humanity, the order of the world, an existence that transcends life and death, time and space.」

556:t_1:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me put it in plain terms.」

556:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$集合無意識$$ is 《$$アカシックレコード$$》... the one that knows all... In a word, God.」

556:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is why I tried to make contact with it, to learn the true nature of the unease that has always been within me... the future of despair.」

556:t_1:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hold on a second! That future of despair, is it...!」

556:t_1:36.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is something felt by those who touched $$黒の英知$$, such as $$シャア・アズナブル$$, who became a $$特異点$$, $$皇帝ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, and by you, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s, as well.」

556:t_1:37.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So... did you find out anything?」

556:t_1:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I could only grasp fragmentary images, but the future of despair does exist for certain...」

556:t_1:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I also learned that the one who brings it about is an absolute being beyond human understanding... a higher-dimensional life form called God.」

556:t_1:41.en:
$$ランド$$
「So a being beyond human, huh...」

556:t_1:42.en:
$$メール$$
「Could that be... someone like $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

556:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Could be. When you see that guy's power, you start to feel that way...」

556:t_1:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To investigate that being, we went after the god that exists in this world... 《$$ワイズマン#keyword$$》.」

556:t_1:45.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Wasn't $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ laid to rest by $$キリコ$$ in the $$再世戦争$$?」

556:t_1:46.en:
$$キリコ$$
「He was alive. And the god the $$マーティアル$$ Church worships was none other than him.」

556:t_1:47.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「To win the war of the gods, $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ tried to take $$キリコ$$'s power into himself, but in the end $$キリコ$$ was the one who delivered the final blow.」

556:t_1:48.en:
$$カレン$$
「But you know, $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ wasn't the only one who was alive.」

556:t_1:49.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ had revived $$フィアナ$$ to use as his trump card against $$キリコ$$.」

556:t_1:50.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. Even an arrogant system that calls itself a god does something useful for people once in a while.」

556:t_1:53.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I've left her with $$ゴウト$$ and the others.」

556:t_1:54.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now we've got a reason we absolutely have to make it back alive.」

556:t_1:56.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To do that, we have to stop $$アマルガム$$, which is out to destroy the world.」

556:t_1:57.en:
$$桂$$
「These days $$アマルガム$$ is practically a private organization of Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s big brother, $$レナード$$.」

556:t_1:58.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And under him is Major $$カリーニン$$ of $$ミスリル$$.」

556:t_1:59.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So it isn't a case of him spying on them, then...」

556:t_1:60.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Unfortunately, it seems the Major supports $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan of his own free will.」

556:t_1:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ will explain that.」

556:t_1:63.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whatever it turns out to be, if it's out to wreck the world, we've got no choice but to stop it.」

556:t_1:65.en:
$$桂$$
(But even if we stop $$レナード$$, this world will sooner or later...)

556:t_1:71.en:
$$キラ$$
「To think that such a power existed...」

556:t_1:72.en:
$$アスラン$$
「And it warped the world...」

556:t_1:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I apologize for having kept this information from all of you until today.」

556:t_1:74.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But please understand that the existence of the $$ウィスパード$$ carries that much weight.」

556:t_1:75.en:
$$甲児$$
「Looking at the string of incidents centered on $$かなめ$$, I can accept it easily enough.」

556:t_1:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But why would Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ and $$かなめ$$ have such power...」

556:t_1:77.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It all began 18 years ago, with the first $$時空震動|lc$$ experiment in $$ＡＤＷ$$ history, carried out in what was then $$人革連$$ territory.」

556:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It was an experiment that turned the mental realm into power in order to generate a $$時空震動|lc$$.」

556:t_1:79.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Drawing out dimensional force through the power of the human mind...」

556:t_1:80.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. Though the scale and structure differ, conceptually it can be called the same as the $$スフィア$$s.」

556:t_1:81.en:
$$テッサ$$
「However, the experiment ended in failure, and the two mental waves emitted from it affected the human body.」

556:t_1:82.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The first, the Iota wave, acted on the residents of the research city $$ヤムスク１１$$, where the experiment facility stood, and threw their minds into confusion.」

556:t_1:83.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The other, the Tau wave, spread across the whole world and affected the newborn babies born during the three minutes the wave was being emitted.」

556:t_1:85.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. Infants affected by the Tau wave awakened the ability to receive Black Technology sent from the future.」

メリッサ.evidence: Kurz's first-name address of Mao (Melissa Mao, glossary メリッサ・マオ = Melissa Mao); no bare-name token exists

t_1:21 Kurz's bare メリッサ: proposed new token $$メリッサ$$ (Melissa)
t_1:18 ＫＭＦ/ドッグ kept as 'KMF' and 'Chirico's dog' (no glossary entry for KMF; Scopedog not named in Japanese)

t_1:36 特異点 token used unlinked, 皇帝ズール via robot token as in earlier rows
